About the job
Spreebogen Analytics builds planning and forecasting software for mid-sized retailers and wholesalers. Since our Series B in spring 2026 we have grown to 140 people in Berlin and Lisbon and serve more than 400 customers in eleven countries. Our ARR is in the low double-digit millions and grew by around 70 percent last year.

Until now, our finance setup has been lean: an in-house finance manager, a controller, an external tax advisor for bookkeeping and payroll, and a lot of spreadsheets. With the next funding round planned for 2028 and our first statutory audit ahead, we want an experienced finance leader to build the function with us. We think the right setup for the next year is a fractional CFO rather than a full-time hire. This is an interim assignment with the option to discuss a permanent role later.

What you will do
• Own the finance roadmap and lead our finance manager and controller
• Set up monthly reporting for the board and our VC investors, including SaaS metrics such as ARR, net revenue retention, gross margin and CAC payback
• Build a driver-based budget for 2027 and a rolling cash runway forecast
• Prepare the company for its first audit under German GAAP (HGB) and move bookkeeping in-house
• Select and implement an ERP and a planning tool suitable for the next three years
• Prepare the data room, the financial model and the equity story for the Series C
• Advise the founders on pricing, unit economics and hiring plans

What you bring
• 8+ years in finance, including at least 3 years as CFO, VP Finance or Head of Finance
• Experience in venture-backed software or tech companies and with SaaS metrics
• Experience with equity fundraising and investor relations
• Hands-on mentality: you build the model yourself when needed
• Fluent English; German is required for the audit and tax topics

Engagement
• Fractional: 2 days per week, flexible across the week
• Start: Q1 2027
• Duration: 12 months, with the option to extend or convert into a permanent role
• Remote-first; one day per month in our Berlin office for the board meeting
• Day rate: €1,100 plus expenses
